articles.title: NASA's Roman Telescope Wakes Up a 300-Megapixel Eye on the Universe
articles.summary: NASA powered up a 300-megapixel infrared camera on the Roman Space Telescope. It can photograph a sky area larger than the full moon and is now a million miles from Earth.

articles.title: Stanford Study: The Human Brain May Actually Be Two Separate Organs
articles.summary: New Stanford research suggests the brain is built from two distinct systems that evolved separately. One controls breathing; the other handles language and abstract thought. The finding could unlock studies of ALS and SMA.

articles.title: Antimatter: The Rare Twin of Matter That Vanishes on Contact
articles.summary: Antimatter is made of antiparticles with opposite charges to normal particles. When matter and antimatter meet, they annihilate. Scientists at CERN moved antiprotons in a truck for the first time in March 2026.
